brief.summary: The show was risk-off. Oil surged, with Brent around $105 and WTI in triple digits after a Saudi output slump and Iran escalation. Bond yields rose to multi-year highs, front-end and long-end, as Treasury buybacks failed and a 30-year auction loomed; equities fell about 0.5-0.6%, while the dollar strengthened versus the euro and yen. The Fed is priced to hike next week (~70%), the ECB hiked, and the BOJ is expected to follow. The dominant narrative is energy-led inflation and fiscal/term-premium pressure offsetting resilient AI/earnings strength, with consumers strained by affordability and geopolitics escalating.
notable_quotes: The earnings are exceptional. I don't really see anything that's troubling.
Ultimately, it is a toxic brew, and bonds respond.
